articles.title: Putin discusses info threats posed by emerging technologies with Security Council
articles.summary: President Putin held a Security Council meeting focused on threats to Russia's information security from emerging technologies.

articles.title: Putin notes formation of partnerships by Russian Export Center with friendly states
articles.summary: Putin met with Russian Export Center Director General to discuss successful partnerships with friendly nations aimed at increasing exports by two-thirds by 2030.

articles.title: IN BRIEF: Putin comments on Russia's strategic goals, security, Duma election
articles.summary: Putin addressed a United Russia party congress, discussing Russia's strategic plans, national security, and pledging that elections will proceed as scheduled in September.

articles.title: West's preparations for war with Russia, its readiness to respond: Putin's comments
articles.summary: At a military academy meeting, Putin said Western countries are openly preparing for war with Russia and noted the Russian army is advancing on multiple fronts.
